
```{r setup}
library(R2jags)
library(polspline)   # only used to compare CMDE with the old logspline estimate

fit_file   <- "Data/summary/sem.rds"
cog_file   <- "Data/summary/sem_cog.rds"          # cognitive score matrix passed to JAGS (needed for CMDE)
bf_file    <- "Data/summary/sem_bf10.rds"         # CMDE Bayes factors
sigma_file <- "Data/summary/sem_sigma.rds"        # posterior draws of the 10 x 10 covariance matrix
theta_file <- "Data/summary/sem_theta.csv"        # posterior mean ability theta per person and task

# Task order follows the paper (Task 1-10)
perc_tasks <- c("TPi", "TLetter", "TGabor", "SPi", "SLetter", "SGabor")
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")         # OSPAN, CSPAN, SSPAN, UCMRT
vis_names  <- c("V", "Bwd", "Spa", "Pi", "Letter", "Gabor")  # non-cognitive factors, l = 1..6
all_tasks  <- c(perc_tasks, cog_tasks)
J     <- length(perc_tasks)     # 6
nCog  <- length(cog_tasks)      # 4
nTask <- J + nCog               # 10
L     <- length(vis_names)      # 6 non-cognitive factors; factor L + 1 = cognitive

prec_obs <- 1e6                 # observed cognitive score = c_iq with SD 0.001

# posterior mean [95% CI]
ci <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean(x), quantile(x, .025), quantile(x, .975))
```

```{r data}
# Process perception data: log transform, then standardize within task
perc_df <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv")
perc_df$correct_num <- ifelse(perc_df$correct == "True", 1, 0)
perc_df$x_raw <- ifelse(perc_df$staircase == 2, perc_df$param1, perc_df$param2)
perc_df <- perc_df[perc_df$x_raw > 0, ]
perc_df$x <- log(perc_df$x_raw)
perc_df$x <- ave(perc_df$x, perc_df$task_name, FUN = function(v) as.numeric(scale(v)))

# Exclude (subject, task) cells flagged as NA in the cleaned scores (4 SD criterion)
clean_scores    <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv")
clean_scores$id <- as.character(clean_scores$id)
excluded_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perc_tasks, function(t) {
  bad_ids <- clean_scores$id[is.na(clean_scores[[t]])]
  if (length(bad_ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(id = bad_ids, task_name = t, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
perc_df$id <- as.character(perc_df$id)
perc_df <- subset(perc_df, !(paste(id, task_name, sep = "_") %in%
                             paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name, sep = "_")))

# Map subject id and task name to indices (task index j = paper's Task number)
ids <- sort(unique(perc_df$id))
perc_df$id_idx   <- match(perc_df$id, ids)
perc_df$task_idx <- match(perc_df$task_name, perc_tasks)
I <- length(ids)

# Aggregate Bernoulli trials -> Binomial counts
agg_df <- aggregate(correct_num ~ id_idx + task_idx + x, data = perc_df,
                    FUN = function(v) c(k = sum(v), n = length(v)))
agg_df <- data.frame(agg_df[, 1:3], y = agg_df$correct_num[, "k"], n = agg_df$correct_num[, "n"])

# Cognitive scores: standardized, higher = better (no sign flip)
cog <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv")
cog$id <- as.character(cog$id)
cog <- reshape(cog, idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide")
names(cog) <- gsub("^score\\.", "", names(cog))
cog[, cog_tasks] <- scale(cog[, cog_tasks])
cog <- unname(as.matrix(cog[match(ids, cog$id), cog_tasks]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cog))
saveRDS(cog, cog_file)
```

```{r model-data}
# Support of Lambda (10 x 7): 1 = free loading, 0 = fixed at zero
# columns: V, Temporal, Spatial, Pi, Letter, Gabor, Cognitive
free <- rbind(
  TPi     = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0),
  TLetter = c(1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0),
  TGabor  = c(1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
  SPi     = c(1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0),
  SLetter = c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
  SGabor  = c(1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0),
  OSpan   = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1),
  CSpan   = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1),
  Corsi   = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1),
  Matrix  = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(free), all_tasks))

jags_data <- list(
  N = nrow(agg_df), I = I, J = J, nCog = nCog, nTask = nTask, L = L,
  id = agg_df$id_idx, task = agg_df$task_idx, s = agg_df$x,
  y = agg_df$y, nTrial = agg_df$n,
  eps = 1e-6, precObs = prec_obs,
  free = unname(free), cog = cog
)

# Init theta using per-task probit MLE:  p = Phi(beta * (s + theta))
mle_theta <- matrix(NA, I, J)
mle_beta  <- numeric(J)
for (j in 1:J) {
  sub <- subset(perc_df, task_name == perc_tasks[j])
  sub$id <- factor(sub$id, levels = ids)
  cf <- coef(glm(correct_num ~ 0 + id + x, data = sub, family = binomial(link = "probit")))
  b_hat <- cf["x"]                                  # slope = beta
  a_hat <- cf[grepl("^id", names(cf))]              # Phi(a + b x) = Phi(b (x + a / b))
  mle_theta[match(sub("^id", "", names(a_hat)), ids), j] <- a_hat / b_hat
  mle_beta[j] <- b_hat
}
for (j in 1:J) mle_theta[is.na(mle_theta[, j]), j] <- mean(mle_theta[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
mle_theta <- apply(mle_theta, 2, function(v) pmin(pmax(v, quantile(v, .02)), quantile(v, .98)))  # trim extreme MLEs

inits <- function() list(
  mu      = c(colMeans(mle_theta), rep(0, nCog)),
  beta    = mle_beta,
  lam_raw = matrix(.3, nTask, L + 1),
  delta   = c(rep(.5, J), rep(.7, nCog)),
  b       = rnorm(L, 0, .1),
  zeta    = matrix(rnorm(I * (L + 1), 0, .1), I),
  gamma   = cbind(mle_theta + matrix(rnorm(length(mle_theta), 0, .02), I), cog)
)
inits_clean <- function() lapply(inits(), unname)
```

```{r run}
pars <- c("mu", "beta", "Lambda", "delta2", "b", "r",
          "share_gen", "share_mask", "share_stim", "share_uni",
          "Sigma", "theta",
          "zeta")                                   # zeta (= eta_1..eta_L, and residual of eta_{L+1}) is needed for CMDE

# 4 chains x 20,000 retained iterations, thinned by 10 -> 8,000 posterior draws
fit <- jags(data = jags_data, inits = inits_clean, parameters.to.save = pars,
            model.file = "Model/sem.jags",
            n.chains = 4, n.iter = 450000, n.burnin = 50000, n.thin = 100)
saveRDS(fit, fit_file)

sl <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.list

# Diagnostics: Gelman-Rubin Rhat (free loadings only)
summ <- fit$BUGSoutput$summary
lam_free <- sprintf("Lambda[%d,%d]", row(free)[free == 1], col(free)[free == 1])
key  <- grepl("^(mu|beta|b|delta2|share_gen|share_uni)\\[", rownames(summ)) | rownames(summ) %in% lam_free
cat("Max Rhat:        ", max(summ[key, "Rhat"]), "\n")
cat("Min n_eff:       ", min(summ[key, "n.eff"]), "\n")
cat("Posterior draws: ", nrow(sl$b), "\n")

# ---- save covariance matrix and individual abilities ------------------------
Sigma <- sl$Sigma                                  # draws x 10 x 10
dimnames(Sigma) <- list(NULL, all_tasks, all_tasks)
saveRDS(Sigma, sigma_file)
Sigma_mean <- apply(Sigma, c(2, 3), mean)
R_mean     <- apply(Sigma, 1, cov2cor)             # posterior mean of the correlation matrix
R_mean     <- matrix(rowMeans(R_mean), nTask, dimnames = list(all_tasks, all_tasks))
write.csv(round(Sigma_mean, 4), "Data/summary/sem_sigma_mean.csv")
write.csv(round(R_mean, 4),     "Data/summary/sem_corr_mean.csv")

theta_mean <- apply(sl$theta, c(2, 3), mean)       # persons x tasks (larger = better)
theta_sd   <- apply(sl$theta, c(2, 3), sd)
dimnames(theta_mean) <- dimnames(theta_sd) <- list(ids, perc_tasks)
excl <- paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name)   # excluded cells were imputed: set to NA
for (t in perc_tasks) theta_mean[paste(ids, t) %in% excl, t] <- NA
write.csv(data.frame(id = ids, theta_mean, check.names = FALSE), theta_file, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(id = ids, theta_sd,   check.names = FALSE), "Data/summary/sem_theta_sd.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r table1}
# Table 1: proportion of variance of each perception task due to each source
shV <- sl$share_gen
shM <- sl$share_mask
shS <- sl$share_stim
shU <- sl$share_uni

tab_shares <- data.frame(
  Task     = c(perc_tasks, "Average"),
  General  = c(apply(shV, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shV))),
  Masking  = c(apply(shM, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shM))),
  Stimulus = c(apply(shS, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shS))),
  Unique   = c(apply(shU, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shU)))
)
print(tab_shares, row.names = FALSE)

# P(average stimulus share > average masking share)
mean(rowMeans(shS) > rowMeans(shM))
```

```{r table2}
# Table 2: correlation r_l of each non-cognitive factor with the cognitive factor,
# and Savage-Dickey BF10 for b_l = 0 (prior b_l ~ N(0, 1)),
# with the posterior density at 0 estimated by CMDE (Morey et al., 2011).
#
# Conditional on the sampled latent factors, the residuals zeta_{i,L+1} and the
# cognitive-task parameters, b is multivariate normal:
#   cog_iq ~ N(mu_q + lambda_q (b' x_i + zeta_i,L+1), delta2_q + 1/precObs),  x_i = (eta_i1..eta_iL)
#   b | rest ~ N(V X' s, V),  V = (I / prior_sd^2 + tau X'X)^-1
#   s_i = sum_q lambda_q r_iq / d2_q,  r_iq = cog_iq - mu_q - lambda_q zeta_i,L+1,  tau = sum_q lambda_q^2 / d2_q
# The posterior density of b_l at 0 is the average over draws of N(0; m_l, V_ll).
cmde_bf10 <- function(sl, cog, prec_obs, prior_sd = 1) {
  zeta <- sl$zeta                                   # draws x I x (L + 1)
  M <- dim(zeta)[1]
  cidx <- (J + 1):nTask                             # cognitive tasks
  dens0 <- cond_mean <- matrix(NA_real_, M, L)
  for (m in 1:M) {
    X    <- zeta[m, , 1:L]                          # I x L   (eta_il = zeta_il for l <= L)
    lam  <- sl$Lambda[m, cidx, L + 1]               # loadings of cognitive tasks on cognitive factor
    d2   <- sl$delta2[m, cidx] + 1 / prec_obs
    R    <- sweep(cog, 2, sl$mu[m, cidx]) - outer(zeta[m, , L + 1], lam)   # I x nCog
    s    <- as.numeric(R %*% (lam / d2))
    tau  <- sum(lam^2 / d2)
    V    <- solve(diag(L) / prior_sd^2 + tau * crossprod(X))
    mb   <- as.numeric(V %*% crossprod(X, s))
    cond_mean[m, ] <- mb
    dens0[m, ]     <- dnorm(0, mb, sqrt(diag(V)))
  }
  list(bf10 = dnorm(0, 0, prior_sd) / colMeans(dens0),
       cond_mean = colMeans(cond_mean))
}

res  <- cmde_bf10(sl, cog, prec_obs)
bf10 <- setNames(res$bf10, vis_names)

# Sanity check 1: E[m] must equal the posterior mean of b
print(rbind(cmde = res$cond_mean, mcmc = colMeans(sl$b)))

# Sanity check 2: compare with the old logspline estimate
bf10_ls <- sapply(1:L, function(l) dnorm(0, 0, 1) / dlogspline(0, logspline(sl$b[, l])))
print(rbind(cmde = bf10, logspline = bf10_ls))

saveRDS(bf10, bf_file)

b_post <- sl$b;  colnames(b_post) <- vis_names      # regression weights b_l
r_post <- sl$r;  colnames(r_post) <- vis_names      # correlations r_l with the cognitive factor

tab_cor <- data.frame(
  Factor = vis_names,
  r      = apply(r_post, 2, ci),
  BF10   = round(bf10, 2)
)
print(tab_cor, row.names = FALSE)

# Variance of the cognitive factor explained by V
ci(r_post[, "V"]^2)
```
